exposure: Anemia at the time of delivery
cohort: 30,674 deliveries between October 2015 and September 2020 at Woman's Hospital, a tertiary hospital in South-Central Louisiana
finding: Black race, increased BMI, cesarean delivery, and anemia were associated with an increased risk of PPH, while anemia at delivery further increased the risk for severe maternal morbidity among those experiencing PPH.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was significantly associated with PPH (aOR = 8.796; 95%CI = 7.731-10.007).
